name: Berd
desc: Open-source desktop app for getting work done with AI agents.
desc_zh: 用 AI 智能体干活的开源桌面应用。
solves: Agent work used to mean one more browser tab; Berd gives it a desktop window that takes whichever model you point it at.
solves_zh: 过去用智能体只是多开一个浏览器标签；Berd 给它一个桌面窗口，接哪家模型都行。
best_for: You run several agents at once and want one window instead of a tab per tool.
best_for_zh: 同时跑好几个智能体，想用一个窗口而不是每个工具开一个标签。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — opensource.block.xyz showcase and github.com/block/berd/releases）。 GitHub renders the release date relatively ("released this 14 Aug"); read on 2026-11-25 that means 2026-08-14. 首次公开日期来源：https://github.com/block/berd/releases/tag/v0.6.0
